decision: The PV final join is ONE 512-b beat-stream slice qkd_pv_fin_s (die element pvfin, master qkd_pvfin, kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_pv_fin_s) placed W of the attention hub between the two PV pair strips, feeding the beat-stream result face qkd_attn_result_face_s in kvs_attn (bundle fin 534 b). NOT the 16,384-b ot_qwen_tp8_pv256_finalize_static_cal.

why.staggered_ages: qkd_pvw_die_t emits column s y at out_age + COL_D[s] - COL_D[0] (0..-42 edges, plan pv_trunk_t col_age_delta_vs_col0); the 16-kb finalize captures all 32 blocks on ONE P0/P1 slot -> needs 512 x sum(spread) deskew pads or per-slice ages
why.distributed_sources: each pair result leaves 32 column joins spread over its 12.0-mm frame (2 x 16 rows, 1468.8-um row pitch); the pair has no out_leaf transport today (po has no stations)

monolithic_tile.arithmetic: 512 FP32 add (LAT 7) + 512 FP32 mul (LAT 6), ~66k data flops + unit pipelines

stream_tile.arithmetic: 16 FP32 add (LAT 7) + 16 FP32 mul (LAT 6) (the reference per-block lanes, time-multiplexed over 32 beats)
stream_tile.flops_est: ~25-30k (operand taps 2 x (SKEW+2) x 512, saved_sum / out 1024, rz 256, unit pipelines)
stream_tile.outline_status: placeholder until the remote gate reports std area (resize to util 0.52)

pins.S: p0_* 534 (pair 0 stream, from the pair-0 strip below)
pins.N: p1_* 534 (pair 1 stream, from the pair-1 strip above)
pins.E: ck, rst_n, start/epoch/cal 65, rz_* 145 (hub W face 30 um away)

stream_tile.pin_ranges: full faces 14..245 um for the 512-b buses, pin_balance M4/M5

why.latency: no added edges vs the 16-kb join + face: beats leave in order 0..31 one per edge (the face emitted 32 beats anyway); the pin stage (+1) is F_DLY=1 in the face (RESULT_AGE identical to the 16-kb face when R <= max(P0, P1), bench)

exactness.fin: rtl/test/qwen_split/run_qkd_pv_fin_s.sh: lockstep vs ot_qwen_tp8_pv256_finalize_static_cal (beat b = ref out_data[512b +: 512], edge = ref + 1 + b); MUT 1 (head index) / 2 (operand tap) must fail; NEG 1-3 (beat index, epoch, missing beat) must fault

buses.ks_pvfin: pvfin.fo -> kvs_attn.fin (534 b, ~12 mm: the result word to the D2D end exists in every variant)

die.flag: OT_KV_PVFIN (default = OT_KV_STATIC_DIE); OT_KV_PVFIN=0 restores the 16-kb face and the old open

opens.owner: PV pair successor (pv_trunk_gen): 512-b registered RESULT TRUNK in the CT next to the e trunk; column joins hold y (registered, updated only at J_OUT), each injects at its compiled slot through a 2:1 inject station (new small relay-standard leaf), beat order 0..31, exit at the strip corner facing pvfin; ~23k flops per pair vs ~0.9M for 32 parallel chains
KVE static hub ot_qkd_ahub_static_die_cal rz_vector / rz_epoch + R_AGE slot (legacy qkd_ahub has only debug native_reciprocal)
price cal {R, P1, P0} at pvfin (pair trunk + relay edges) and attn_face F_DLY = 1 + ks_pvfin relay stages

followups: consider moving kvs_attn beside pvfin (pvst / pvfst / fin short; att_tx 548 b to the D2D long instead): equal wire, fewer centre-top convergences
